name: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
description: You are given an array of strings tokens that represents an arithmetic expression in a Reverse Polish Notation. Evaluate the expression and return an integer that represents the value of the expression. Note that: The valid operators are '+', '-', '*', and '/'. Each operand may be an integer or another expression. The division between two integers always truncates toward zero. There will not be any division by zero.
